bead.title: opencode: wire real token usage into final event via ResolveFinalUsage
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Even after the parser captures step_finish.tokens, runner.go:136-150 still builds FinalUsage from the old agg.InputTokens/OutputTokens ints with UsageSourceNativeStream, ignoring reasoning/cache dimensions and not using the shared resolver. codex routes usage through harnesses.ResolveFinalUsage(agg.UsageSources) (codex/runner.go:146), which normalizes provenance, freshness, and warnings.

ROOT CAUSE: internal/harnesses/opencode/runner.go:136-150 hand-rolls FinalUsage; the opencode streamAggregate does not expose UsageSources []harnesses.UsageCandidate like codex (codex/stream.go:61-65,220-245).

PROPOSED FIX: Change opencode streamAggregate to hold UsageSources []harnesses.UsageCandidate and a recordUsage that builds UsageTokenCounts (input/output/reasoning, cache read/write/total) from step_finish.part.tokens, tagged harnesses.UsageSourceNativeStream. In runner.go:136-150 replace the manual block with final.Usage, final.Warnings = harnesses.ResolveFinalUsage(agg.UsageSources) (mirror codex/runner.go:146). Keep CostUSD from part.cost.

NON-SCOPE: tool events; parser line-scan (assumes the parser-rewrite bead landed).
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestRunner_Execute_RealUsageFromStepFinish: running the text_only.jsonl fixture through a fake-binary Execute yields final.Usage.InputTokens==13505, OutputTokens==3, ReasoningTokens==18, Source==harnesses.UsageSourceNativeStream.
2. final.Usage is nil when the stream carries no step_finish (no silent zero — preserve the provenance rule usage_provenance_test.go checks).
3. Rewrite usage_provenance_test.go to use real step_finish JSONL instead of the fictional {"usage":...} envelope.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
